name: Noah du Eirrault
source:
Noah has a savage wit and blunt manner that make him an odd choice for an emissary.
So odd that you can't help wondering what he is even doing here... beside having a wonderful time trying to fluster you that is.

Keep an open mind and you may find your views of the world challenged in the best possible way.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/490618601/queens-crown]Kickstarter[/url]]
